name: Splitter for iOS
subtitle: A native speedrun timer for iPhone and iPad.
description: Builds of Splitter for iOS, a SwiftUI speedrun timer built on livesplit-core.

versions.localizedDescription: Game icons from speedrun.com: in the splits editor, tap Find on speedrun.com to use the game's cover art as its icon. Icons from Photos now work with iPhone photos too.

Live Activity: your running timer and current split on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Adds Current Pace, Sum of Best and Possible Time Save, a landscape layout, optional tap-anywhere-to-split, keyboard shortcuts, and a richer library with game icons and PB times.
The timer's controls go back to standard buttons; the Liquid Glass styling on them didn't look right.

Accessibility and design update: higher-contrast split colors with a color-blind-friendly option (timer menu > Split Colors), star markers on gold segments, VoiceOver describes ahead/behind, Dynamic Type support, Edit button in the splits editor, reopens your last splits on launch, Liquid Glass controls on iOS 26, and light/dark mode outside the timer.
Fixes the "Couldn't open splits" error shown when Splitter is opened from AltStore.
Import GreenSplit (.gss) splits with attempt history, golds, comparisons and subsplit groups. Fixes the splits editor and timer list for runs with subsplit groups.
First release of Splitter for iOS.

apps.name: Splitter
apps.subtitle: Speedrun timer powered by livesplit-core
apps.localizedDescription:
A native speedrun timer for iPhone and iPad, built on livesplit-core.

• Imports Splitter .split files, LiveSplit .lss and Splits.io .json
• Big Start/Split button with haptics, plus Undo, Skip, Pause and Reset
• Ahead/behind and gold-segment colours, comparisons, Real/Game time
• Edit splits on the device; runs autosave as .lss in the Files app
